seriesTitle: Knights of the Zodiac: Saint Seiya

episodes.title: SEIYA
episodes.summary: After exhibiting special powers, Seiya is approached by the enigmatic Alman Kido, who urges him to fulfill his destiny and become a Bronze Knight.

episodes.title: Burn Your Cosmo
episodes.summary: Seiya obtains the Pegasus Armor with ease, but to be a true Knight of Athena, he must first prove himself in the Galaxian Wars tournament.

episodes.title: Enter the Dragon
episodes.summary: Believing in the dark prophecy, Magnus confronts Lady Sienna. Seiya faces his toughest opponent yet: Dragon Long.

episodes.title: Nebula Chain
episodes.summary: Reluctant to fight, Andromeda Shaun takes a defensive approach against Unicorn Jab using her Nebula Chain. Meanwhile, Vander's army attacks.

episodes.title: The Black Knights
episodes.summary: Seiya takes down a helicopter to retrieve the stolen Gold Armor from Phoenix Nero, only to be confronted by Vander's Black Knights.

episodes.title: Phoenix Rising
episodes.summary: Phoenix Nero has built up his overwhelming power with hate. To stop him, the Bronze Knights must combine their strength to reclaim the Gold Armor.

episodes.title: The Silver Knights
episodes.summary: Seiya awakens, having survived the collapsing volcano. He quickly learns Sanctuary has sent Silver Knight Misty and his old master Marin to kill him.

episodes.title: The Rising Tide
episodes.summary: Fearing for Sienna's safety, Marin orders Seiya to protect her. Alone, Marin faces the Silver Knights Hound Asterion and Whale Morris.

episodes.title: To Fight for Athena
episodes.summary: Reunited with the Bronze Knights, Seiya and the others search for Sienna. Silver Knight Jamian the Crow appears, determined to stop them.

episodes.title: The Challenge
episodes.summary: Perseus Argol's Medusa Shield turns its opponents into stone. One of the Bronze Knights makes a life-altering decision to protect Sienna.

episodes.title: The Prophecy
episodes.summary: Guraad assembles his own Black Knights to protect mankind from the gods. When his forces abduct Sienna, the Bronze Knights set out to rescue her.

episodes.title: One War Ends, Another Begins
episodes.summary: The Bronze Knights face Guraad's upgraded Black Knights. Though Seiya and the others gain the upper hand, Guraad proves to be a formidable foe.

episodes.title: Battle for the House of Leo
The One as Powerful as a God
Return to the Land of the Dead
Absolute Zero
episodes.summary: In the House of Aquarius, Cygnus Magnus must battle to the death against Gold Knight Camus, his former master. But if he has any hope of winning, Magnus must utilize everything Camus has ever taught him.

episodes.title: Demon Roses
episodes.summary: With only one hour left, time is running out for the Bronze Knights. As they reach the House of Pisces, Andromeda Shaun seeks to avenge her master's death by defeating his killer, Gold Knight Aphrodite.

episodes.title: Andromeda's Sacrifice
episodes.summary: In the House of Pisces, Andromeda Shaun continues her life-and-death battle against her master's killer, Gold Knight Aphrodite. In the midst of the struggle, Shaun flashes back to the events in her past that molded her and made her who she is.

episodes.title: Death Match in the Grand Master's Chambers
episodes.summary: Seiya is near-death, downed by the deadly Demon Roses. He must find a way to stay alive and survive as he nears his goal - to reach the Grand Master.

episodes.title: The Man with Two Faces
episodes.summary: As the final flame on the clock tower is about to burn out, Seiya confronts the Grand Master and discovers his shocking true identity. In the face of the Grand Master's overwhelming power, Seiya must dig deep if he hopes for any chance of victory.

episodes.title: The Face of the Grand Master
episodes.summary: Phoenix Nero returns to join the battle against the Grand Master. The two battle as more secrets are revealed about the Grand Master's fate. But as both Sienna and Seiya lie near-death, is it all too little too late?

episodes.title: To Save Athena!
episodes.summary: At the top of Sanctuary, time has almost run out and the epic battle is nearly ended. Now the fate of the universe hangs in the balance as Seiya makes one final desperate attempt to save Sienna.
